result.title: Hard or Mislabeled? Failure Screens Enrich Vision Benchmarks for Label Errors
result.summary: Hard vision benchmarks often keep images that strong classifiers get wrong. Since a classifier is also marked wrong when the label is wrong, such failure screens may collect label errors. We measure this on ImageNet's twice-relabeled validation set with 103 classifiers. Among the 1,892 images that all 66 supervised classifiers get wrong, 61% have a wrong label, versus 11.1% overall. The fewer images a screen lets through, the more of them are mislabeled, along approximately one curve. Fit on one model family, this curve predicts the screens of two held-out model families with a mean error of 2.4 percentage points, and replays of ImageNet-D's and ImageNet-Hard's screens within 0.1 and 6.3 points. On new pools, ImageNet-V2 and CIFAR-10, enrichment at the strictest screens is stronger than the curve predicts: on ImageNet-V2, by human relabeling, 67% of the images that all 66 classifiers get wrong are mislabeled, against 46% predicted. Screens that let models choose among only some of the classes, as ImageNet-A's does (200 of 1,000), fall below the curve. By ReImageNet, 32% of ImageNet-Hard's ImageNet images have no correct label. ScreenAudit, which comprises an audit tool, a script that rebuilds corrected answer sets for the 5,464 decided ImageNet-Hard images (of 5,646) from ReImageNet's gated release, and per-image audits of 1,198 benchmark images, will be released later.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 ImageNet 双重重标注验证集上用 103 个分类器测量「难样本筛选」引入的标签错误：所有 66 个监督模型都错的 1,892 张图中有 61% 标签错误（整体 11.1%），并给出可按筛选严格度预测错误富集比例的拟合曲线，以及审计工具 ScreenAudit。
AI.relevance_reason: 「难样本可能只是标错」这一结论与富集曲线、逐图审计可供核查 LVR/多模态推理基准的困难样本，避免把标签噪声误判为推理失败，从而影响对 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益与成本结论的解读。
